title: Perihelion clustering of extreme trans-Neptunian objects
statement: Report the Rayleigh test of the longitudes of perihelion of the extreme trans-Neptunian objects in the pinned MPC distant-object snapshot of 2026-10-18 under a stated selection in semi-major axis and perihelion distance. A witness states the selection, the objects it picks out, and the statistic; the checker recomputes all three from the snapshot and accepts the witness only if they agree.
witness_format: JSON object: a_min_au, q_min_au, optional exclude (list of packed designations with a one-line reason each), designations (list of packed designations the selection yields), n, mean_resultant_length, p_rayleigh, mean_longitude_of_perihelion_deg
